note.text:
A physical quantity is anything that can be measured with an instrument and written as a number with a unit.
Examples: length (2.5 m), mass (50 kg), time (30 s), temperature (37 °C), volume (1.5 L), area, speed, weight.
A non-physical quantity cannot be measured with an instrument and has no unit. Examples: love, kindness, beauty, honesty, happiness, fear, anger, courage.
We can talk about them and feel them, but there is no instrument or unit to measure them.

worked_example.problem: Is “the height of a mango tree” a physical quantity? Is “how much Bih likes mangoes”?
steps: The height of the tree can be measured with a measuring tape, in metres: it is a physical quantity.
How much Bih likes mangoes cannot be measured with an instrument and has no unit: it is not a physical quantity.
worked_example.answer: The height is a physical quantity; how much she likes mangoes is not.

cards.idea: A physical quantity can be measured with an instrument and written as a number with a unit.
example: Length: {a} m. Mass: {b} kg. Time: {c} s.

cards.idea: Love, kindness, beauty and fear are not physical quantities: no instrument measures them and they have no unit.
example: We can feel happiness, but we cannot write “happiness = {k} kg”.

cards.idea: Every physical quantity has a unit: metres for length, kilograms for mass, seconds for time.

questions.prompt: Which unit can be used to measure {x.t}?

misconceptions.explain: That unit is for a different quantity.

questions.prompt: Why is kindness NOT a physical quantity?

right.text: No instrument can measure it, and it has no unit.

wrong.text: Because it is too small to see.
wrong.explain: Small things can still be measured. Kindness has no instrument and no unit.

wrong.text: Because it changes from day to day.
wrong.explain: Temperature changes too, and it is a physical quantity. The reason is: no instrument, no unit.

wrong.text: Because only scientists can measure it.
wrong.explain: No one can measure it: there is no instrument and no unit.

questions.prompt: One sentence is wrong. Which one?

right.text: Mass is a physical quantity measured in kilograms.
Time is a physical quantity measured in seconds.
Beauty is not a physical quantity.
Temperature can be measured with a thermometer.

wrong.text: Happiness is a physical quantity measured in metres.
wrong.explain: Happiness cannot be measured with an instrument and has no unit.

wrong.text: Length is not a physical quantity.
wrong.explain: Length is measured with a ruler, in metres: it is a physical quantity.
